scenarios.title: Edit pull request diff textarea and check placeholder and label update
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the textarea for diff input updates its aria-label from 'Unified diff' to 'Diff' while keeping the placeholder unchanged to improve accessibility.

steps.value: Paste a unified diff here, or enter a GitHub pull request URL above.

scenarios.title: Clear diff content resets state and disables clear button
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that clicking clear diff button empties the diff textarea, clears results and errors, and disables the clear button.
